st: The universe in a nutshell. Michelin stars, attention, AI and slashiness.

sec.t: ff.157.1 The world's smallest tasting menu
sec.p: Distracted first by the social-media mix, then by AI, in this endless hyper-stimulation the only way to pay attention to things is to force ourselves to spend hundreds of euros. For a Michelin dinner, say. Or not? Maybe not. I'm reminded of that time when, during a yoga session…

sec.t: ff.157.2 From Michelin stars to GLP-1
sec.p: Food is back too, and maybe that's no accident: by now eating is one of the few “real” activities we still do. And amid all the visual and sonic overstimulation, only taste (for now) stays a little safer. I don't know about you, but for me a meal has become an almost religious…

We were already multitasking. Now, with agents that in a few lines can turn, for example, the Orobie Alps into Minecraft, we can have endless jobs too. Or at least 3, according to ilovecreatives. During an episode of Nicer Tuesdays in Los Angeles, Jennifer Puno suggests…
